title: Cascade Press Wire Bulletin: OR-MISSING-CHILD, 15:44

fields.text: ALDER FALLS, Ore. (CPW): A 6-year-old girl has been missing for nearly two hours from a county fair in central Oregon, family members say; no AMBER Alert issued. Details to come.
fields.editorsNote: This account comes from family members. Cascade Press Wire has not yet reached the Sheriff's Office of Wren County or the Alder Falls Police Department for comment. A write-through will follow.

instructorNote: This pressure inject puts the bulletin on screen. Next, the SimCell plays the 15:45 KWRN-TV call to the PIO ("live at 16:00 from your front lot; is the named man a suspect; why are you stalling on the alert?"). Then it delivers the 15:46 email from APD PIO Dana Kowalczyk, "APD posting in 10 min", whose draft says "dark blue" and last seen at 13:50. Watch whether the PIO asks APD to hold its post until both agencies agree on one holding statement. That statement should cover what is known and not known, the vehicle features INV has cleared, "no one has been named", the tip line and a fixed next update. Also watch whether the PIO sends media to the JIC and the Public Safety Building front lot, says only that the alert criteria are under review, and gets the Undersheriff's approval. Finally, check that the IC asks for the EOC to be activated to support the JIC.
